runtime: ECMAScript module; runtime-neutral SHA-256; no DOM, network or filesystem I/O

assumptions: Crankshaft boundary; package supplies LHV and fuel density
Nonnegative torque inside package operating range and source envelope
Null cells and validity masks are retained; no extrapolation
Processed/extrapolated source grids retain their evidence class; not all cells are measurements

equations: Original per-speed fuel curve interpolation followed by interpolation between speed rows
assumptions: Model-estimated ICE Design output; no uniform fuel grid or measured data invented

implementationAuthority: SI adapter uses the canonical ice-core numerical kernels; all application copies are verified distributions.
status: Adopted by Automobile and ICE through the common pinned bundle.
limitations: Engine packages only; motor packages require a separate boundary adapter
No automatic replacement of the vehicle engine curve or carrier
No idle, overrun, cold-start or transient correction in Automobile cycle integration
Hashes identify retained content; they do not authenticate a publisher
